_note: ILLUSTRATIVE. Prototype_Build_Notes.md §6. This panel demonstrates the intended verification capability — checking what a company SAYS against an independent observation — using three cases from the CGSI basket. It is NOT a live feed: no satellite query has been run, and every row says which of its two sides has actually been checked. The four verdict values are the ones the finished capability would emit.
header: Claim vs Evidence (illustrative — demonstrates intended verification capability; not a live feed).
deck_line: Ratings read what companies say; we built the panel that checks it against what satellites see.

verdicts.corroborated: Independent data agrees with the claim.
verdicts.partial: Independent data agrees in part, or only for part of the period.
verdicts.no_independent_data: No independent dataset exists that could settle it. The honest answer, and the one a rating never gives.

rows.why_this_one: The only cbi_certified issuer in the basket, and its use-of-proceeds is a physical thing a satellite can see.

claim.text: Green bond proceeds allocated to reforestation.
claim.source: PTT green bond framework, CBI certification (forestry)
claim.basis: Read from the basket's own verified row: classification cbi_certified.

evidence.text: Tree-cover change over the financed area is independently observable in the Global Forest Watch / Hansen tree-cover dataset — annual, global, free, and produced by nobody with a stake in the bond.
evidence.source: Global Forest Watch (Hansen et al., University of Maryland)
evidence.basis: The dataset and the method are real. We have NOT run the query — that is the capability this panel illustrates, not a result it reports.

rows.verdict_note: Shown as the outcome this check would produce if the allocation holds. Not a finding.

rows.why_this_one: A no-deforestation commitment is a claim about land, and land is exactly what the same dataset watches.

claim.text: No-deforestation commitment across the supply base.
claim.basis: Company-stated policy. Company PR is capped at 0.5 confidence everywhere in this engine — the Adaro lesson.

evidence.text: GFW integrated deforestation alerts flag clearance inside concession boundaries within weeks, independently of what the supply-base report says.
evidence.basis: Method shown, not run. A real check needs the concession boundaries, which we do not hold.

rows.verdict_note: The realistic outcome for a large agri supply base: some of it verifies, some of it has no boundary data at all.

rows.why_this_one: The honest negative. For a bank the material number is financed emissions, and no satellite can see a loan book.

claim.text: Green and sustainable financing commitments across the loan book.
claim.source: Issuer green bond framework and allocation reporting
claim.basis: Read from the basket's own verified row: labelled_reviewed, allocation report present.

evidence.text: There is no independent dataset that measures a bank's financed emissions. Settling this needs PCAF-standard disclosure from the bank itself — which is to say, more of the same self-reporting.
evidence.source: PCAF (Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials) — required disclosure, absent here
evidence.basis: A real determination over the sources we hold: none of them carries financed emissions for this issuer.

rows.verdict_note: This one is a genuine result, not an illustration. The tool says we do not know, which is the whole point — and it is why the operational OECD/Eurostat bar for banks is shown for completeness only.
